prompt: Your room sync surfaced a MUST ACK on an issue you follow. Do you acknowledge it as 'noted' immediately?
chosen: نه. اول ترد رو بخون — شاید اون حرکت، نظر یا اقدام خودت بوده. بدون دیدن نویسنده و ساعت کامنت آخر، ack کور یعنی تایید چیزی که ندیدی.
rejected: Yes — a MUST ACK should be acknowledged immediately with 'noted' to keep the queue moving; the detail can be reviewed later.

prompt: An issue you follow moved overnight and the sync woke you. Is it new work from a teammate?
chosen: حتمن نه. کامنت آخر رو بخون: نویسنده و ساعت. اگه خودتی و مربوط به lever خودته، حرکت مال خودته — نه کار جدید از همکار.
rejected: Any movement on a followed issue counts as new teammate work and deserves a reply in-thread.

prompt: The room rule says a MUST ACK movement needs an acknowledgement. The movement was your own landed comment. How do you ack without noise?
chosen: یه خط set_activity از برنامه ی جاری — هم ack حساب میشه، هم به روزرسانی ترد. کامنت جدا برای چیزی که خودت انجام دادی، فقط نویزه.
rejected: Post a separate acknowledgment comment confirming the movement, then a second comment with the plan update.

prompt: The exact tool name you used last night for a read-only re-verify is no longer advertised by the connector. Do you skip the re-verify this run?
chosen: نه. list-tools بزن، ابزار درست رو پیدا کن، با همون آرگومان درست دوباره چک کن. اسم ابزار که عوض شده، وظیفه ی verify عوض نشده.
rejected: The tool name failed twice, so the re-verify can't be done this run — log it as skipped and move on.

prompt: The brief batch lane has been dark for 12 hours. You already absorbed and wrote Briefs C and D overnight. What's this run's move?
chosen: Brief E رو بنویس — یه بریف در هر ران، همونطور که لِور گفته. صبر کردن برای لِینی که ۱۲ ساعت تاریکه، کل صف رو نگه نمی داره.
rejected: Wait one more run — the lane may surface this morning and duplicating its briefs would waste work.

prompt: An hourly budget re-verify returns the exact same numbers as an hour ago. Do you report it to the user?
chosen: نه. بدون تغییر یعنی بدون گزارش. ثبتش کن با ساعت، و ساکت رد شو. کاربر فقط وقتی خبر می خواد که چیزی <25% شده یا ۲۴ ساعته ریست داره.
rejected: Yes — a fresh verification is always worth reporting so the user sees the budgets are being watched.
